claim: At EVERY original complex point in every nonzero chart, construct a WHOLE finite faithful two-variable polynomial normalization with identity analytic derivative and a genuine centered local inverse. Produce exact chosen-normalization finite fraction/primitive/smooth-derivative-open consumers, and prove the full-root-model local-injectivity/simple-root boundary bridge. The final actual boundary derivative nonvanishing and global candidate smoothness remain explicit downstream joins.

obligations.name: Whole finite normalization
obligations.required_input: Actual original chart dimension2 and whole finite old normalization.
obligations.constructed_input: Original algebraic upper/lower trdeg bounds force the normalization variable count2.
obligations.justification: Original algebraic upper/lower trdeg bounds force the normalization variable count2.

obligations.name: Whole finite perturbation
obligations.required_input: Arbitrary prescribed elements and old whole finite normalization.
obligations.constructed_input: Literal integral equations, prechosen coefficient degree bounds, strict pure-power reduction and actual intermediate subalgebra give whole new finite map.
obligations.justification: Literal integral equations, prechosen coefficient degree bounds, strict pure-power reduction and actual intermediate subalgebra give whole new finite map.

obligations.name: Actual scalar structures
obligations.required_input: Old and new polynomial bases must not be conflated.
obligations.constructed_input: Old equations retained with explicit old eval₂; new scalar structure installed only afterward; scalar extension preserves SAME numerical degrees.
obligations.justification: Old equations retained with explicit old eval₂; new scalar structure installed only afterward; scalar extension preserves SAME numerical degrees.

obligations.name: Specified center and first jet
obligations.required_input: New normalization must have the original prescribed tangent derivative at chosen point.
obligations.constructed_input: Literal coordinate translation and M≥2 powers vanish for every actual point derivation; original ratio left inverse yields identity derivative.
obligations.justification: Literal coordinate translation and M≥2 powers vanish for every actual point derivation; original ratio left inverse yields identity derivative.

obligations.name: Analytic inverse and faithfulness
obligations.required_input: Whole new normalization must be faithful, not only finite.
obligations.constructed_input: Actual C1 evaluation, identity derivative and IFT give genuine local inverse; open evaluations and polynomial identity principle prove same map injective.
obligations.justification: Actual C1 evaluation, identity derivative and IFT give genuine local inverse; open evaluations and polynomial identity principle prove same map injective.

obligations.name: Exact fraction and primitive certificate
obligations.required_input: Chosen g must produce finite fraction structure and whole fiber primitive separator.
obligations.constructed_input: Exact lifted inclusion/tower and algebraicity plus essential finite type yield finite extension; primitive evaluation surjectivity and full fiber separation are produced.
obligations.justification: Exact lifted inclusion/tower and algebraicity plus essential finite type yield finite extension; primitive evaluation surjectivity and full fiber separation are produced.

obligations.name: Actual smooth neighborhood consumer
obligations.required_input: Derivative-open must be actual original candidate open and contain specified point.
obligations.constructed_input: Literal same-g minpoly derivative localization is smooth with exact complex-base square; actual specified evaluation lifts whenever derivative nonzero.
obligations.justification: Literal same-g minpoly derivative localization is smooth with exact complex-base square; actual specified evaluation lifts whenever derivative nonzero.

obligations.name: Boundary root multiplicities
obligations.required_input: No simple-root hypothesis may be assumed at tested boundary.
obligations.constructed_input: Continuous residual quotient retains fixed degree and multiplicities; local WHOLE root-model injectivity and genuinely dense separable fibers force derivative nonzero.
obligations.justification: Continuous residual quotient retains fixed degree and multiplicities; local WHOLE root-model injectivity and genuinely dense separable fibers force derivative nonzero.

obligations.name: Remaining actual join
obligations.required_input: Do not infer global smoothness or isomorphism from generic lemmas.
obligations.constructed_input: Actual candidate projection local injectivity must still be transferred to its chosen primitive root model, then simple-root theorem applied; global smoothness and line-bundle comparison remain downstream.
obligations.justification: Actual candidate projection local injectivity must still be transferred to its chosen primitive root model, then simple-root theorem applied; global smoothness and line-bundle comparison remain downstream.
